messages.content: 你可以幫我找到紐約的四家餐廳，提供義大利菜餚，並符合我素食和無麩質的飲食需求嗎？然後再找四家洛杉磯的餐廳，提供同樣類型的食物，也符合我的飲食需求嗎？

We should call the function with location "New York" and food_type "Italian", number 4, dietary_requirements ["vegetarian", "gluten-free"].

Then call again with location "Los Angeles".

    "location": "New York",

Then second call.
